🚂 Western Adventure with Mom

5ZionSaturday, September 12

  • 10:00 AMLeave Kanab · Mt. Carmel Tunnel, Checkerboard Mesa & highway pullouts
  • NoonShuttle up-canyon — every stop is a viewpoint · lunch at Zion Lodge
  • 7:00 PMBack to Kanab · pack up tonight

6Las VegasSunday, September 13

  • 10:00 AMDrive to Vegas (3½ hr · Pacific Time is 1 hr behind Utah)
  • ~12:30 PM PTArrive Las Vegas · drop the rental car, returned right at the hotel BOOKED
  • 4:00 PMHotel check-in BOOKED
  • Evening on the Strip: Bellagio fountains & conservatory, dinner out

7A Whole Day in VegasMonday, September 14

  • Second night on the Strip BOOKED car is gone, so no driving, no packing, nowhere to be
  • Slow morning · late breakfast · the Bellagio conservatory is free and fully indoors
  • Afternoon at your pace — shops and lobbies are all air-conditioned and connected
  • Last dinner out, and the fountains one more time after dark

8Homeward BoundTuesday, September 15

  • Breakfast · ~11:00 AMCab or rideshare to Harry Reid Intl, about 15 minutes
  • 1:30 PMMom flies home · Southwest 421, nonstop to Pittsburgh, in at 8:55 PM BOOKED · CP5V93
⚠ Fix first: the Vegas room is booked Sunday only — we need Monday night too (~$200), since Mom now flies home Tuesday. Also push the car return from 10 AM to Sunday afternoon; we do not reach Vegas until about 12:30. Still open: Denver, Provo and Kanab hotels.
Good to know: Arizona (Page, North Rim) is 1 hour behind Utah in September. The North Rim sits at 8,000 ft — bring layers even on warm days. One park pass covers Bryce, the North Rim, and Zion.

🗺️ Map

Reading the map: dashed gray is the Zephyr, Denver to Provo. Coloured lines are our drives — everything after Thursday runs out and back from Kanab. Numbers match the days in the itinerary.

📸 What We'll See

Ruby Canyon from the Zephyr · Wednesday evening
Red sandstone walls along the Colorado River, best from the Sightseer Lounge at sunset.
Bryce Canyon hoodoos · Thursday afternoon
Thousands of orange stone spires from Sunset Point; the paved rim path at the lots is gentle and flat.
Grand Canyon, North Rim ⭐ · Friday
Layered canyon walls from Point Imperial, steps from the car, 8,000 ft up. Quieter and greener than the South Rim. The lifelong dream.
Zion Canyon · Saturday
2,000-ft sandstone walls above the Virgin River. Every shuttle stop is a viewpoint; lunch at the historic Zion Lodge.
Bellagio fountains · Sunday evening
A short walk from where we are staying. They run every 15 minutes after 8 PM, set to music, and the last show is at midnight.
